feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 6 May 2026 7:30am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 06 May 2026 at 7:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Weak ridge of high pressure will build over Scotland and the North Sea today.


##Wind##

East or southeast 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in the south of the area at first. Veering south or southeast 3 or 4 this evening, then generally south 3 or 4 tonight, but 5 at times in east of area.


##State of Sea##

Slight, possibly slight or moderate in the east tonight.


##Weather##

Isolated showers at first today, otherwise fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in the east of the area, then becoming 4 or 5 in all waters later in the day. Falling variable 2 or 3 overnight into Friday.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally slight or moderate in places.


##Weather##

Scattered showers for a time, otherwise fair.


##Visibility##

Good, possibly moderate in showers.
